purpose: Freeze the graph-randomization, lesion, seed, and equal-compute rules before closed-loop navigation results are observed.
selection_prohibitions: do not select rewire seeds by poor performance
do not change lesion definitions after benchmark results
do not change graph threshold based on intact-vs-rewire separation
do not allocate more training compute to intact than rewired variants
do not discard failed or inconvenient rewires
claim_boundary: E004a freezes fair controls only. It does not compare behavioral performance and cannot support a real-vs-rewired navigation claim by itself.
